builder.idea: Lighthouse Search Sprint: A high-performance web accessibility and SEO auditing tool that automates Lighthouse report generation and provides actionable remediation insights for developers.
reuse: OpenAI API integration for automated remediation suggestions
steps: Set up a Node.js environment with Lighthouse CLI for automated site auditing.
Develop a dashboard to ingest URLs and generate comparative performance reports.
Implement an LLM-based analysis module to translate Lighthouse audit failures into plain-English code fixes.
Create a report export feature (PDF/JSON) for user documentation.
Perform final testing against common web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1).
demo_risks: Inconsistent Lighthouse scores due to network latency during remote testing.
Potential API rate limits if using external LLMs for remediation analysis.
Lack of organizer transparency regarding prize payout verification.
